method.threshold_selection: None: declared grid applied in full; no winning threshold/model is selected
method.split: Original five outer test folds, exact-once 486-prompt coverage; ID-aligned for all policies
method.uncertainty: Paired prompt bootstrap stratified by fixed outer test fold; candidate minus reference
method.uncertainty_limits: Conditional on fixed masks/scores, not retraining variance; shared contexts and multiplicity unaccounted for
method.risk_semantics: UNRELIABLE/10 evaluator judgments per strictly eligible prompt; not next-answer certainty
method.verification_assumptions: Residual risk multipliers 0, .5, 1 on escalated prompts are hypothetical, not measured
method.false_reassurance: Mean empirical risk among normal-path prompts; also report fraction of such prompts with any unreliable attempt
method.remaining_risk_denominator: All original prompts; assumes verification returns answers with q times original empirical risk. For abstention use coverage and normal-path risk instead.
method.hash_reference: SHA256 fixed salt/ID ordering within each outer test fold; exact matched counts; no outcomes used
method.operational_impact: Not established; retrospective routing sensitivity only
